_about: Index of Native Instruments' official Guitar Rig manual, so a lookup goes straight to the right page instead of guessing or inventing. Only titles, URLs and topic keywords are stored here — no manual text is reproduced. Fetch the page when you need the wording.
_note: There are no per-component pages. `components-reference` is one long page holding every component in every category; fetch it and search within it.

sections.relevant_to_this_project: The authoritative source for what a parameter means. components.json knows a parameter's id, name and observed range; this page says what it does. Note that Native Instruments describes hardware obliquely — 'a renowned synthesizer manufacturer', 'a legendary American amplifier' — rather than naming brands, so gearmap.json stays an interpretation.

facts_confirmed.midi_storage: Global: preset selection, Rack Tools parameters including Macros, and Global FX parameters. Per preset: ordinary Rack component parameters and Container parameters. This matches the two files the tool reads — Controller Assignments.shm globally, remotecontroldb inside each preset.
facts_confirmed.automation_id_note: This decodes the automation-number attribute in <host-automationdb>. A value of 263 or 276 is a header parameter, not a rack component — which is why rackbuild.py must keep those entries when it prunes the table.
facts_confirmed.macro_overrides_automation: A parameter assigned to a Macro ignores automation on its own ID, to avoid conflicting changes.

gr7_component_names._about: Names as the Guitar Rig 7 manual lists them. Several differ from what Guitar Rig 6 presets record, which matters when matching a scanned dictionary against a catalog.

in_gr6_not_listed_in_gr7_manual.explanation: Not missing. The components-reference page covers signal processors only; Modifiers (Analog Sequencer, Envelope, Input Level, LFO, Step Sequencer) and Tools (Container) have their own manual sections, and Global FX is a Rack Tool. All seven still exist.

gr7_component_names._method: Computed by comparing the Guitar Rig 7 manual's component reference against catalog.json (read from a Guitar Rig 6 install), after applying renamed_since_gr6. Absence from the GR7 list is not proof of removal — it may be a naming difference not yet mapped.
